slices.focus: Caleb handles a Gulf storm threat with better routines, maintaining reflux discipline and delegating a public meeting to Miguel rather than spiraling into all-week vigilance
slices.summary: A tropical threat in the Gulf triggers Caleb's old storm anxiety patterns, but he handles it differently this time. He keeps his reflux routine steady, limits forecast checking to set windows, and delegates one public meeting to Miguel. The experience shows him that the edge of anxiety can be contained rather than endless, and he creates a five-line storm-week coping checklist.
open_loops: Write five-line storm-week checklist: forecast windows, no late spicy food, meds on time, delegate early, phone cutoff at night
